name.ja: 30MF 鎧真伝サムライトルーパー 灼熱のガイ
name.en: 30MF Armor Shinden Samurai Trooper Burning Guy

description.ja: 2026年1月放送開始のTVアニメ『鎧真伝サムライトルーパー』より主人公の「凱」を30MFフォーマットで立体化！
description.en: From the TV anime "Shinden Samurai Trooper ", which started airing in 20261, the main character " Gai" is made into a 30MF format!

description.ja: ■パーツの差し替えで「アンダーギア」から「ヨロイギア」への変身が可能。
description.en: • It is possible to transform from "Under Gear " to " Armor Gear" by replacing parts.

description.ja: ■ヨロイギア召喚シーンの再現用ハンドパーツとエフェクトが付属。
description.en: • Comes with hand parts and effects to recreate the Armor Gear summoning scene.

description.ja: ■タンポ印刷を施した2種類のフェイスパーツが付属。
description.en: • Two types of face parts with tampo printing are included.

description.ja: ■印刷無しのフェイスパーツと、多数のバリエーションから表情を選択できる水転写式デカールが付属。
description.en: • Comes with unprinted face parts and water transfer decals that allow you to choose from a wide variety of expressions.

description.ja: ■武装には「刀」が2本付属し、鞘から抜刀が可能。
description.en: • Two "katana" are included as weapons, and the swords can be drawn from the sheath.

accessories.ja: 表情パーツ(タンポ印刷)×2種
accessories.en: Facial expression parts (tampo printing) x 2 types

accessories.ja: 表情パーツ(水転写式デカール用)×1種
accessories.en: Facial expression parts (for water transfer decals) x 1 type

accessories.ja: ヨロイギア再現用パーツ×1式
accessories.en: Armor gear reproduction parts x 1 set
